tr1_c1.mo_ta: Morning at the front door. Bông wears her red school bag, steps out and waves back to Mom, who stands in the doorway smiling.

tr1_c2.mo_ta: At the front gate, Bông turns and waves to the kitten sitting on the doorstep.

tr1_c3.mo_ta: At the classroom door, Ms. Deer welcomes the children; Bông bows politely to her.

tr1_c4.mo_ta: Inside a bright classroom, Bông stands at the front and opens her arms wide to greet the class; Anna, Little Bunny and Little Bear wave back from small tables.

tr1_c5.mo_ta: In the schoolyard, Bông meets Anna face to face; they hook little fingers and smile.

tr1_c6.mo_ta: Afternoon at the school gate. Bông walks out with her bag and waves back to Ms. Deer.

tr1_c7.mo_ta: Bông arrives home; the puppy runs out of the yard to greet her, tail wagging.

tr1_c8.mo_ta: Early evening. Dad comes home from work with his bag; Bông runs to hug him at the door.

tr2_c1.en: One, two, three, four, five, six!
tr2_c1.mo_ta: Living room with balloons. Bông, Mom and Dad lean over a birthday cake with exactly six lit candles and point at the candles one by one.

tr2_c2.mo_ta: At the open front door, Anna holds a wrapped gift and puts one hand on her chest, introducing herself; Bông opens the door.

tr2_c3.mo_ta: Anna asks with an open palm toward Bông, curious and friendly.

tr2_c4.mo_ta: Bông answers with one hand on her chest, smiling proudly.

tr2_c5.mo_ta: The two girls shake hands happily in the living room.

tr2_c6.mo_ta: Next to the cake, Anna asks Bông a question, tilting her head.

tr2_c7.mo_ta: Bông holds up six fingers (one full hand and one finger) beside the six-candle cake.

tr2_c8.mo_ta: Anna holds up one full hand, five fingers, smiling.

tr3_c1.mo_ta: Bông and Anna sit on a sofa with Bông's photo album open. Anna points at a photo of an old man, looking curious.

tr3_c2.mo_ta: Close view of the album: the photo shows Bông's grandfather; Bông smiles and points at him.

tr3_c3.mo_ta: Anna points at a photo of an old woman on the next page.

tr3_c4.mo_ta: The photo shows Bông's grandmother; Bông answers happily.

tr3_c5.mo_ta: Bông points at a photo of her big brother, raising her other hand high to show he is tall.

tr3_c6.mo_ta: Bông points at a photo of her little sister, lowering her other hand to show she is small.

tr3_c7.mo_ta: Now Anna opens her own album and shows a photo of her big sister.

tr3_c8.mo_ta: Anna shows a photo of her baby brother; both girls laugh.
